name: Start the TARDIS
oracle_text:
Surveil 2, then draw a card. You may planeswalk. (To surveil 2, look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
Jump-start (You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs. Then exile this card.)

needs.what: the Planechase subsystem (rule 901): a planar deck per game, a face-up plane or phenomenon in the command zone, and a `planeswalk` op (701.31) that puts the current plane on the bottom of the planar deck and turns over the next one, firing its "When you planeswalk to/away from" triggers; wrapped in `may` for "You may planeswalk"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op, zone object or game setup in the reference knows planes, phenomena or a planar deck; `planeswalk` appears nowhere in `ops`, and Planeswalker-related keys (`or_planeswalker`, `must_attack_planeswalker`) are about the card type, not the Planechase action. A `noop` in its place would silently drop the clause. The rest of the card is expressible: surveil + draw as spell_effects, and Jump-start as `graveyard_cost: {discard: 1, mana: "{1}{U}"}` as Radical Idea ships it
